note: Set B is better because it correctly extracts the 'SOLAR ENVELOPE' height and location, which Set A misses entirely. Set B also correctly binds the L3x3x1/4 angle to the East Elevation, whereas Set A incorrectly assigns it to the West Elevation (which uses L4X4X5/16). While Set B has some misbound HSS sections (assigning HSS4X6 to East/West instead of South), Set A contains invented attributes (weight derived from section name) and more vague, trivial claims.
